explanation: Random-variable form of the Courtade–Kumar conjecture (arXiv:2609.24931): any probability space with measurable X, Z whose joint law is uniform ⊗ i.i.d. Bernoulli(p) (true = flip with probability p), Y = X ⊕ Z, satisfies I(f∘X; Y) ≤ 1 - h(p) in bits. This is exactly the standard probabilistic setup (independence of X and Z and i.i.d. noise are encoded by the product law). The file proves it equivalent to the elementary statement. Faithful.
